title: Aureline M5 constrained-file-state descriptor
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a read-only or policy-locked constrained current object. Names the object class, its owning-source association, the constrained-state badge, the blocked-write reason, the allowed-versus-blocked action set, and the mutation-blocked posture so a current object that cannot be written in place is never rendered as directly writable by omission. Downstream tab chrome, breadcrumbs, the status bar, the command palette, editor banners, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a class's constrained-file-state meaning by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
